purpose: Foundational candidate collection, not publication or completed evidence review
search_scope: Bounded initial Europe PMC search; synthesis and non-OA reports retained

search_runs.question: 1RM measurement
search_runs.query: (TITLE_ABS:"one repetition maximum" OR TITLE_ABS:1RM) AND (TITLE_ABS:reliability OR TITLE_ABS:prediction)

search_runs.question: Load, volume and frequency
search_runs.query: (TITLE_ABS:"resistance training") AND (TITLE_ABS:strength) AND (TITLE_ABS:"network meta-analysis" OR TITLE_ABS:"dose response" OR TITLE_ABS:periodization)

search_runs.question: Autoregulation and failed repetitions
search_runs.query: (TITLE_ABS:powerlifting OR TITLE_ABS:"resistance training") AND (TITLE_ABS:autoregulation OR TITLE_ABS:"repetitions in reserve" OR TITLE_ABS:"RPE")

search_runs.question: Rest intervals
search_runs.query: (TITLE_ABS:"resistance training" OR TITLE_ABS:"strength training") AND (TITLE_ABS:"rest interval" OR TITLE_ABS:"interset rest")

search_runs.question: Assistance transfer
search_runs.query: (TITLE_ABS:squat OR TITLE_ABS:"bench press" OR TITLE_ABS:deadlift) AND (TITLE_ABS:"exercise variation" OR TITLE_ABS:"exercise selection" OR TITLE_ABS:transfer)

search_runs.question: Hypertrophy and strength
search_runs.query: TITLE_ABS:"resistance training" AND TITLE_ABS:hypertrophy AND (TITLE_ABS:load OR TITLE_ABS:volume)

search_runs.question: Sleep recovery and fatigue
search_runs.query: (TITLE_ABS:"resistance training" OR TITLE_ABS:"resistance exercise" OR TITLE_ABS:powerlifting) AND (TITLE_ABS:"sleep restriction" OR TITLE_ABS:recovery OR TITLE_ABS:fatigue)

search_runs.question: Plateau and deload
search_runs.query: (TITLE_ABS:"resistance training" OR TITLE_ABS:powerlifting) AND (TITLE_ABS:deload OR TITLE_ABS:plateau OR TITLE_ABS:overreaching)

search_runs.question: Peaking and taper
search_runs.query: TITLE_ABS:powerlifting AND (TITLE_ABS:taper OR TITLE_ABS:peaking OR TITLE_ABS:cessation)

search_runs.question: Time frequency and missed sessions
search_runs.query: TITLE_ABS:"resistance training" AND (TITLE_ABS:"time efficient" OR TITLE_ABS:"reduced frequency" OR TITLE_ABS:detraining)

search_runs.question: History and load selection
search_runs.query: (TITLE_ABS:"resistance training" OR TITLE_ABS:powerlifting) AND (TITLE_ABS:"load selection" OR TITLE_ABS:"RPE" OR TITLE_ABS:"repetitions in reserve")

search_runs.question: Adherence and adverse events
search_runs.query: (TITLE_ABS:powerlifting OR TITLE_ABS:"resistance training") AND (TITLE_ABS:adherence OR TITLE_ABS:"adverse events" OR TITLE_ABS:dropout)
